source_snapshot.items: SMM TSEG Range should cover the entire SMM region
source_snapshot.procedure: Flash a BIOS-RD debug BIOS, open BMC SOL, use AMI RU at I/O space register 0xB2, and verify that SmiHandler4 is absent; then collect results/photos and inspect post-test logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: SmiHandler4 must be skipped and the response must be human readable.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; requires a debug BIOS, AMI RU and BMC SOL and proposes recording the handler list.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: BLOCKED; title asks for TSEG range coverage while the procedure and criterion observe SmiHandler4, with no defined equivalence.

old_problem: The title requires a range-containment property for all SMM TSEG memory, but the only source procedure and oracle are an undocumented I/O 0xB2 action and absence of SmiHandler4 in a debug SOL trace. The source does not define how that trace proves the titled property.
disposition_reason: This is not a missing runtime parameter that can be safely parameterized. The authoritative test property, platform register model, debug instrumentation semantics and recovery contract remain absent. ED-51 explicitly preserves this decision rather than choosing either interpretation. User decisions ED-01 through ED-30 add safety and evidence rules but do not supply the missing case-specific semantic mapping.
decision_basis: Exact Functionality row 708 was reopened from the protected XLSX and matched Source Key, Variant ID and row hash.
The same-row DeepSeek and GPT V2 records were read; DeepSeek identifies the operator boundary but does not resolve the semantic conflict.
ED-51 requires the owner to choose TSEG range validation versus SmiHandler4 debug-trace validation and prohibits an unapproved debug BIOS or register operation.

Intel public register documentation describes TSEG as a platform address range with TSEG memory-base and related memory-map registers; it does not establish that absence of a private SmiHandler4 label proves complete TSEG coverage.
No approved OEM/RD specification defining I/O 0xB2, SmiHandler4, the SMI stimulus or a safe rollback path exists in the repository.

test_case.test_name: SMM TSEG Range should cover the entire SMM region
test_case.purpose: After the owner selects the authoritative branch, either validate complete SMM TSEG address-range coverage from platform-defined base/limit/allocation evidence, or validate the separately defined SmiHandler4 debug behavior. The two branches are not interchangeable.
required_package: BIOS/RD decision selecting the authoritative property
Exact platform/CPU/chipset TSEG register map, units, locks and expected range, if range coverage is selected
Approved debug BIOS and rollback image hashes, AMI RU version, I/O 0xB2 semantics, SMI stimulus and SOL decoder, if handler behavior is selected
Independent OOB recovery procedure and maintenance authorization
test_case.test_command: NOT STARTED — no authoritative executable command exists. Do not flash the debug BIOS or issue AMI RU/I/O 0xB2 operations until BIOS/RD supplies the selected contract.
test_case.expected_result: Unavailable as one unified oracle. A TSEG branch must prove the complete documented protected address interval and lock/state requirements; a handler branch must prove the approved stimulus omits SmiHandler4 while retaining the explicitly expected handlers. Owner approval must state which result governs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS threshold is currently authorized. PASS requires the selected branch's exact expected register/range or handler-sequence oracle and complete raw evidence; FAIL is any deviation from that approved oracle. Until then execution remains BLOCKED, not PASS or N/A.
safety_gate: No debug BIOS flash, undocumented register access or SMI trigger before exact image-to-hardware compatibility and explicit approval
Stable power, verified OOB console, rollback image and recovery owner must be ready
Use read-only access where the approved contract permits; never infer or write an undocumented register
Stop on identity mismatch, lost console/control, boot failure or unexpected security/platform behavior; never automatically retry
expected_evidence: Owner/RD scope decision and authoritative specification
Platform, BIOS/BMC, debug image, AMI RU and decoder versions
If TSEG: raw base/limit/size/lock values and reproducible range calculation against the complete SMM allocation
If handler: defined SMI stimulus and full timestamped SOL trace with required and prohibited handlers
Pre/post boot, BMC, security and log health plus recovery evidence
test_case.recovery: No recovery action is authorized under the current ambiguous testcase. A future handler/debug-BIOS run requires the BIOS-RD-approved rollback image and OOB recovery steps; preserve first-failure evidence and do not retry automatically.

source_conflict.reason: The title's TSEG range property and the procedure/criterion's SmiHandler4 behavior remain materially different and no controlling source connects them.

blocked.reason: Core semantics, authoritative expected result and safe firmware/register recovery are unresolved.

pending.missing_evidence: A source-key-specific decision selecting the property, its authoritative register or handler contract, expected result and recovery package.
pending.release_condition: Publish the approved corrected review-layer contract and re-review this exact Source Key; do not edit the protected Master in this task.
